name: tokenguard
description: Local-first AI coding assistant: answers simple questions with a local Ollama model and sends hard ones to a cloud LLM with only the relevant, secret-redacted code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Reads workspace files for routing context, indexes the repo, and runs the agent loop that stages edits and commands in the workspace.

commands.title: Move LocalPilot to Right Side Bar

viewsWelcome.contents:
The LocalPilot chat opens in the right side bar.
[Open LocalPilot Chat](command:localpilot.chatView.focus)

tokenguard.apiUrl.description: Address of an already-running LocalPilot backend to reuse (e.g. one started with `make backend`). When the extension starts its own backend it binds a free port instead of using this.

tokenguard.autoStartBackend.description: Start the LocalPilot backend as a child process on a free port when the chat is first opened (and stop it on exit). Ignored if a backend already answers on tokenguard.apiUrl.

tokenguard.backendPath.description: Development override: path to a backend/ folder (e.g. in a TokenGuard checkout). Empty: the backend bundled with the extension.

tokenguard.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter for the backend; it must already have the backend dependencies installed. Empty: a venv the extension creates in its storage folder on first run (from an installed Python 3.9+, or a downloaded standalone Python if none is found), or <repo>/.venv for a source checkout.

enumDescriptions: Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Groq, OpenRouter, self-hosted) — set tokenguard.customBaseUrl
Mock provider: no real cloud call (for demos only)
tokenguard.cloudProvider.description: Global (cloud) LLM provider used for escalated/complex prompts. Sent to the backend with each request; overrides CLOUD_PROVIDER in backend/.env.

tokenguard.cloudModel.description: Model name for the selected provider (e.g. deepseek-chat, gpt-4o-mini, claude-sonnet-5-5). Empty: the provider/model default in backend/.env.

tokenguard.customBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the `custom` OpenAI-compatible provider (e.g. https://api.groq.com/openai/v1). Sent to the backend as X-LLM-Base-Url.

tokenguard.cloudModelsAutoFetch.description: Fetch the provider's model list for the sidebar picker (uses the API key). Disable to avoid the extra request.

tokenguard.localModel.description: Ollama model used for local inference (e.g. qwen2.5-coder:0.5b). Empty: LOCAL_MODEL from backend/.env. Pick one from the LocalPilot sidebar dropdown.

tokenguard.ollamaUrl.description: URL of the local Ollama server.

tokenguard.preloadLocalModel.description: Load the selected local model when the chat opens so the first local prompt is warm (it stays loaded until exit).

tokenguard.autoStartOllama.description: Start `ollama serve` when the chat is first opened, if it isn't already running. Ollama is stopped again when VS Code closes.

tokenguard.stopOllamaOnExit.description: On exit, stop the `ollama serve` process that TokenGuard/setup started. Local models are always unloaded to free RAM; an Ollama you started yourself (e.g. a systemd service) is never killed.

tokenguard.agentInlineReview.description: When the agent finishes, open each modified file with its changes marked in place (red = removed, green = added) and Accept / Reject above each change, like Cursor. Nothing is saved until every change in the file is decided.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
